subject: tasks.records

entries.definition: An actionable unit of tracked work with portable lifecycle, context, optional assignee and date, and optional typed relationships to Projects and Meetings.
An explicitly resolved workspace actor responsible for a Task; it is never inferred from a CRM contact or external participant.
The exact calendar date selected for the next Task action without implying scheduling, reminder delivery, or Calendar authority.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable Task meaning only; it grants no provider, approval, execution, or health authority.
Project and Meeting relationships are optional typed resource identities rather than required Context dependencies.
